database_queries.name: schema
database_queries.sql: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'ext' AND table_name = 'local_signals_cache' ORDER BY ordinal_position;

database_queries.name: cache_history
database_queries.sql: SELECT now() AS sampled_at, asof AS cache_asof, expires_at, payload->>'asof' AS payload_asof, payload#>>'{weather,obs_time}' AS weather_obs_time, payload->'weather' AS weather, payload->'location' AS location, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_object_keys(payload)) AS payload_keys FROM ext.local_signals_cache WHERE zip = '78754' AND asof > now() - interval '6 hours' ORDER BY asof DESC LIMIT 24;

database_queries.name: latest_cache
database_queries.sql: SELECT now() AS sampled_at, asof AS cache_asof, expires_at, payload->'where' AS zip_location, payload->>'asof' AS payload_asof, payload->'weather' AS weather FROM ext.local_signals_cache WHERE zip = '78754' ORDER BY asof DESC LIMIT 1;
